biography:
Meet the Artist


Aishwarya Dake
Artist & Founder, Colors N Joy

I believe the right artwork can transform how a space feels.

Through Colors N Joy, I create original, handcrafted artworks designed specifically for each space—bringing together texture, form, colour and light.

I personally conceptualize and oversee every project, from the initial idea to the final installation.
